dialog.content: So what was the victim's cause of death?
It has to be something that made them lose blood.
Considering the scene of the crime...
...And the fact the body was covered by the shelves...
It probably was just the kitchen knife.
There's no way anyone would kill someone!
It's just too insane! Too cruel!

retry_monologue: What she just said was very off.
I know for a fact it was her!
